primary_metric: complete discovery and selected values into owned buffers; hashes and profile waits excluded
selection_semantics: latest selects ordinal V before predicates; exact selects each logical path's ordinal 1; all includes every scientific version without content folding
namespace_isolation: one independent namespace per system/scenario/V; both formats share that namespace
fs_history: full copied files per ordinal; no hardlinks, symlinks or reflinks; one SQLite index per scenario/V/format covers every version
cache_claim: prepared OS pages, new worker/owner per campaign; no cold-disk claim
inference: pilot only; report all campaign medians and absolute totals, increments, growth and relative advantage; repeated requests are not independent campaigns
